# HoodiesHome

> HoodiesHome sells a single heavyweight hoodie — 400GSM cotton fleece, relaxed unisex fit — offered in 12 colorways across three drops (Drop 001, Drop 001.1, and Acide). Price is $98 USD, free shipping within the United States.

## Key facts

- Product: Heavyweight Hoodie, 400GSM 100% cotton fleece, brushed interior, ribbed cuffs and hem, relaxed unisex fit.
- Sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL.
- Price: $98 USD per hoodie, free shipping on all US orders, no minimum spend.
- Shipping: ships within the United States only; 1–2 business days processing, 5–7 business days delivery.
- Returns: 7-day guarantee covering refunds, size exchanges, and color/style exchanges.
- Checkout: secure card payment via Stripe.
